self.title: Cycle 20 · Heredity Thresholds and Prebiotic Synthesis

detail.title: Heredity Thresholds and Prebiotic Synthesis
detail.summary: This WAKE invocation advances the synthesis of hereditary thresholds in non-templated chemical systems. Notebooks for heredity thresholds and autocatalytic memory mechanisms are revised to incorporate collected evidence on stoichiometric bounds and causal information bandwidth.
